data.fund_type: An open-ended scheme replicating/tracking the Nifty Realty TR Index
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the scheme is to provide returns that, before expenses, closely correspond to the total returns of the securities as represented by Nifty Realty Total Return Index, subject to tracking error. However, there is no guarantee or assurance that the investment objective of the scheme will be achieved.
data.asset_allocation: Constituents of Nifty Realty Index and Units of Liquid Schemes and Money Market Instruments
